model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's studio photo (US model shown; the club's unit is 30921ANZ) and are approximate. The five cutting heads, wheels, battery and boards sit underneath and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3474-136 and operator's manual 3472-242. The serial was not supplied: read the plate.

base.name: Lower housing
base.desc: Lower housing over the cutting heads and wheels. Wet weather, daily: press stop, tip the robot onto its rear, switch off and clear mud and grass off the wheels and cutting heads with a blower, compressed air or wire brush. Body: damp cloth or soapy water, never solvents. 6-monthly: check the wiring under the robot; dealer if damaged.

body.name: Body shell and top cover
body.desc: Main shell. Clean with a damp cloth or soapy water; never solvents. Through the season keep all screws, nuts and bolts tight. Robot weighs 71 kg; maximum slope 30%. Status, alarms, schedules, maps and battery cycles are read in the Toro Turf Pro portal (turfpro.toro.com) and Connect app; there is no hour counter described in the manual.

archL.name: Rear wheel arch, left
archL.desc: Covers the left rear drive wheel. Wire-brush mud and grass off the rear wheels every 40 h, daily in wet weather.

archR.name: Rear wheel arch, right
archR.desc: Covers the right rear drive wheel. Wire-brush mud and grass off the rear wheels every 40 h, daily in wet weather.

housing.name: Top housing
housing.desc: Raised housing between the wheel arches carrying the stop button and two of the sonar sensors.

sidepanel.name: Side panel
sidepanel.desc: Side panel carrying the charge contacts.

stop.name: Stop button cover
stop.desc: Red STOP cover. Press it before tipping or cleaning the robot, then switch off.

contacts.name: Charge contacts
contacts.desc: Every 40 h: rub with 280-grit sandpaper until clean. Daily: check the robot returns to the station and charges and the app shows no alarms. Furrows can form on the station approach: level the ground or lay synthetic turf there.

bumper.name: Bumper
bumper.desc: Bumper kit 164-0086. Every 40 h: check for cuts and tears (dealer if damaged); wipe with a damp cloth, no water. Removable objects such as range targets and flags are not detected: take them off the area before scheduled mowing.

sonar.name: Ultrasonic (sonar) sensors
sonar.desc: Five sonar sensors 164-0084 per robot. Every 40 h: remove mud and grass and wipe with a damp cloth; no water.

heads.name: Cutting heads (x5)
heads.desc: Five floating cutting heads, each with its own motor 163-5590; 1033 mm cut width, electronic height adjust. Every 40 h: clean the heads (compressed air is best); each head must move freely back and forth. After any work, turn each head by hand: turning one must not turn the others. Set cut height per parcel in the menu; a negative value means the parameters were reset and blade height must be re-calibrated (calibration stops 163-3873). Blade disc guard kit 163-3935 (single guard 163-3934) is useful on a range with balls in the turf; ball deflector flaps kit 163-3855 is also listed.

blades.name: Cutting blades (15)
blades.desc: Three pivoting razor blades per head, 15 per robot: 15-pack 163-5574 (50-pack 163-5575, 500-pack 163-5576). Replace all blades every 6 months, sooner if blunt or damaged: remove the screw, fit the new blade and screw, then turn each head by hand to check the heads are independent. Weekly: inspect blades, blade screws and disc assembly. Blade killers: uneven ground and molehills, bare patches, nylon markers, sprinklers, stones, roots, and tall tough weeds along the boundary wire.

discs.name: Cutting discs
discs.desc: Cutting disc kit 163-5579 (no blades), five per robot; blade disc kit 163-5569. Replace a disc if damaged or not spinning smoothly. Clean the discs weekly (critical at 25 mm cut or lower). Standard Height Cutting Discs Kit 30916 (20-100 mm) or Low Height Cutting Discs Kit 30918 (15-90 mm, also listed as 163-3850).

afdisc.name: Anti-friction discs
afdisc.desc: At 25 mm cut or lower, inspect the white anti-friction disc cover at least every 2 months and replace if worn. Anti-friction disc 163-5528 (x5) comes in free disc kit 163-5816.

frontwheels.name: Front wheels (x4)
frontwheels.desc: Four front wheels 163-5501 on front hub assembly 163-5497. Every 40 h: clean; they must spin freely without excess play, replace when play develops. Clean and inspect the front wheel axle.

rearwheels.name: Rear wheels (x2)
rearwheels.desc: Rear tyre 163-5491 (rear wheel assembly 163-5560), two per robot. Every 40 h: wire-brush mud and grass off. Gearmotors are sealed; Toro lists no greasing.

battery.name: Battery, LiFePO4
battery.desc: Battery 164-0085: LiFePO4 25.6 V, 19.0 Ah, 486.4 Wh; working temperature -5 to +60 C; do not open. About 110 min mowing per charge, about 90 min to full. The robot manages its own cycles: if cycles look short in the portal, the dealer checks the battery. Storage: fully charge, switch off, clean, store dry and frost-free, cover the station (it can stay on). Back into service: switch on, power to the station, check battery voltage on the screen, start and confirm it returns to the station. Same battery number as the Range Pro 100.

fuses.name: Fuses
fuses.desc: Mini blade fuses on the peripheral board and cutting control board: 121-8861 (2 A), 121-8864 (5 A), 121-8867 (15 A).

wiring.name: Wiring under the robot
wiring.desc: 6-monthly: check the wiring under the robot; dealer if damaged. Yearly service by an authorised Toro technician (at least once a year).

rtk.name: RTK base, station and boundary wire
rtk.desc: Shared with the Range Pro: 4G RTK base 30912ANZ, charging station, boundary wire spools 163-3926 / 163-3927 and surge protector kit 163-3925. Remote wake-up, commands and schedules need the 4G/RTK link.

163-5575.name: Cutting blades, 50-pack
163-5575.note: Cheaper per blade for three or more changes.

163-3850.name: Low height cutting discs kit (alt. number)

30916: Standard Height Cutting Discs Kit (20-100 mm)
30918: Low Height Cutting Discs Kit (15-90 mm)
